photos.desc: Exemplar found: Russia, Moscow Oblast, Odintsovsky District, near village Pestovo, 08.08.2017, days МО, Одинцовский р-н, окрестности деревни Пестово, 08.08.2017, днём

Fining down after an incredible year Just a few better moths at the moth trap on the 5th September. A Vapourer Moth and Chinese Character were welcome second broods and a dark form of Acleris variegan
The weather was cold and damp with the moth presumably trying to dry out under the bell push.
